content.bridge_context: This story uses a folktale format to explain the evolutionary and social bond between humans and dogs.

units.title: Domestication of Animals
units.explanation: Long ago, animals lived in the wild. Some animals, like the dog, chose to live with humans for safety and food.
units.dual_language_instruction: Think of the difference between a wolf and a pet dog. / भेड़िये और पालतू कुत्ते के बीच के अंतर पर विचार करें।

units.title: Hierarchy of Strength
units.explanation: In nature, many animals follow the strongest leader for protection.
units.dual_language_instruction: List the animals in the story from weakest to strongest. / कहानी के जानवरों को सबसे कमजोर से सबसे मजबूत के क्रम में लिखें।
